# anecdotes_requirements (Data Source)

Lists all requirements in the Anecdotes Requirements Hub, with optional filtering.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anecdotes_requirements" "all" {}

output "requirement_count" {
  value = data.anecdotes_requirements.all.total_count
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `category` (String) Filter requirements by category (exact match).
- `include_unlinked` (Boolean) Include requirements with no linked controls. Defaults to false — only requirements linked to at least one control are returned.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Filter by custom requirements only (true) or built-in only (false).
- `name_contains` (String) Filter requirements whose name contains this substring (case-insensitive).
- `status` (String) Filter requirements by status. Statuses are tenant-defined (up to 17 per tenant); the defaults are "To do", "In Progress", and "Completed". No fixed value set is enforced.

### Read-Only

- `requirements` (Attributes List) List of requirements matching the filters. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--requirements))
- `total_count` (Number) Total number of requirements matching the filters.

<a id="nestedatt--requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `requirements`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) The requirement category.
- `description` (String) The description of the requirement.
- `is_custom` (Boolean) Whether this is a custom requirement.
- `name` (String) The name of the requirement.
- `requirement_id` (String) The unique identifier of the requirement.
- `status` (String) The requirement status.
- `status_name` (String) The human-readable status name.
